editionData.description: Global headlines: Trump says ground troops unlikely in Iran; Saudi downs drone (President Trump says deployment of ground troops to Iran unlikely as Saudi Arabia downs drone in its Eastern Province); Myanmar’s coup leader-turned-president wins back neighbours despite war (ASEAN leaders are embracing Min Aung Hlaing, but critics warn it emboldens a military still bombing civilians); and Poll shows Bolsonaro with slight lead over Lula ahead of Brazilian run-off (Poll shows right-wing candidate with two percent advantage over Lula going into second round of voting on October 25). Markets leaned higher, with 5 of 7 tracked indexes up; Nikkei 225 up 1.43% was the largest move. Benchmarks tracked: S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, Euronext 100 Index, and Public Joint-Stock Company Moscow Exchange MICEX-RTS plus 3 more indexes. Hacker News: Muse Spark Open (Muse Spark Open is the most capable US open-weight model to date, and brings leading agentic capabilities to your desktop on Apple M5...); Meta’s new commercial terms will allow the scraping of news sites: experts (niemanlab.org: Meta’s new commercial terms will allow the scraping of news sites: experts); and RPKI now protects 70% of internet routes (RPKI now protects 70% of Internet routes. headlines.summary: Manhattan's Upper West Side has been reveling in the company of its latest celebrities: A family of barn owls nested in a water tower atop a building near Central Park.

headlines.title: Brewers sweep the Dodgers to reach the World Series for the first time since 1982
headlines.summary: Propelled by a lockdown bullpen and repeated comebacks, the Brewers swept the two-time defending champion LA Dodgers out of the playoffs Thursday in Game 4 of the National League Championship Series.

headlines.title: Hit a midlife wall? This test identifies your strengths and what matters to you
headlines.summary: As part of her new podcast and newsletter Your Turn with Allison Aubrey, NPR's Allison Aubrey went in search of tools to help navigate midlife — starting with this survey to rank one's character strengths.

headlines.title: Suspicious mailings to election officials, congressional offices under investigation
headlines.summary: The FBI and U.S. Postal Inspection Service are looking into the mailings, some of which included an unidentified powdery white substance.

headlines.title: U.S. historic preservation law faces the most serious threat in its 60-year history
headlines.summary: Congress and a federal agency are threatening to weaken the country's historic preservation law, fueling a backlash that critics say is as fiery as the one that led to the law's creation 60 years ago.

headlines.title: China, Togo to deepen cooperation
headlines.summary: Premier Li Qiang stressed on Thursday that China stands ready to deepen cooperation with Togo in various fields to better serve the modernization drive of both countries, as the two countries issued a joint statement on building a China-Togo community with a shared future in the new era.

headlines.title: Chinese desert fighter honored by FAO
headlines.summary: Three Chinese women, including Yin Yuzhen, who has devoted more than four decades to combating desertification in northern China, were among 100 women heroes in agrifood systems and rural development honored by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations in Rome, Italy, on Thursday.

headlines.title: Brands need more than quality goods to go global, forum says
headlines.summary: Chinese companies are increasingly establishing themselves as global brands, but their long-term international success will depend not only on technological innovation and competitive products, but also on their ability to engage consumers, forge emotional connections, and adapt to local markets, business leaders and experts said at a forum in London on Wednesday.

headlines.title: 3 children, 1 adult killed in US school shooting: media
headlines.summary: SAN FRANCISCO -- At least three children and one adult were killed Thursday in a shooting at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, US state of Oregon, CBS News reported, citing law enforcement sources.

headlines.title: Moderating shift in US views still underway
headlines.summary: A shift in public sentiment in the United States toward China, particularly among younger people, could open more room for a less confrontational approach to bilateral relations, experts said, while cautioning that US public opinion is still evolving and its ultimate impact on policy remains to be seen.

headlines.title: PM Modi to visit to Canada on December 11 and 12
headlines.summary: Prime Minister Modi will visit Canada December 11-12, 2026, ahead of a U.S. G20 trip, with broader India-Canada ties and trade talks highlighted.

headlines.summary: India calls for immediate de-escalation, dialogue, and protection of seafarers as West Asia tensions escalate and threaten regional stability.
